heading: **1 November 2025**
body:
### 1. Reconstitution of lig20K with SBP-Octamer \+ TF pool incubation

Low salt RB (2 L)

37.28 g KCl  
20 mL 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.5  
4 mL 0.5 M EDTA  
2 mL DTT

*lig20K (2x)*

Use 3.89 ug of DNA

lig20K (D7) ⇒ 15 uL ⇒ 15 nM \[at 2 M salt concentration\]

Octamer molarity acc. to 60:1 ratio ⇒ 0.9 uM ⇒ 2.11 ug in 5 uL ⇒ Prepare 500 ng/uL stock OSH500 (0.83 uL \+ 11.17 uL refolding buffer) ⇒ (4.22 uL OHS500 \+ 0.78 uL refolding buffer \+ glycerol) \[1.84 M\] ⇒ Final concentration of mix \[1.96 M\]

Post-reconstitution, the assembled nucleosomes are to be enriched with SBP beads to enrich only the fragments of DNA with assembled nucleosomes.

*lig147-L11 (D8)*

Use 2 ug of DNA

lig147-L11 ⇒ 7.7 nM

Octamer molarity acc. to 60:1 ratio ⇒ 462 nM ⇒1.01 ug in 5 uL ⇒ Prepare 12 uL of stock with 500 ng/uL with refolding buffer \[1.11 uL stock \+ 8.89 uL refolding buffer\] \[O500\] ⇒ Prepare 5 uL octamer stock \[3.92 uL \+ 1.08 uL refolding buffer \+ glycerol\] \[1.78 M\] ⇒ Final concentration of mix \[1.95 M\]

### 2. lig147 Recon Test for NCAP-SELEX

Run a test program O/N with Orange Dye and a Plate containing 6.5 uL of water.
